name: GOES (NOAA Weather)
best_known_for: US geostationary weather satellites — pair of GOES-East (75.2°W) + GOES-West (137.0°W) gives continuous coverage of Americas; GOES-16 onward use the Advanced Baseline Imager for 30-second mesoscale scans
credit: NOAA + NASA Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite programme. Operational pair always positioned to cover Americas weather + hurricane tracking.
